			add = 1

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Holy Sponsorship
qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_demand_value
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_offer_points_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
		add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
		add = -3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		add = -5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_marriage ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_marriage_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_ask_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### The Loyal Mole
qpq_loyal_mole_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5

qpq_loyal_mole_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_loyal_mole_ask_value
	add = qpq_loyal_mole_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Licensed Feud
qpq_licensed_feud_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_dossier_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_dossier_ask_value
	add = qpq_dossier_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		add = { value = scope:recipient.intrigue multiply = 1 max = 20 }
	}
}

#### Quiet Removal
qpq_quiet_removal_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_quiet_removal_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_quiet_removal_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_quiet_removal_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_quiet_removal_ask_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 20
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { OR = { has_trait = sadistic has_trait = callous } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_snatch_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_snatch_ask_value
	add = qpq_snatch_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Dispossession
qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispossession_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispossession_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_dispossession_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispossession_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}

	value = qpq_dispossession_demand_value
}

	value = 0
	if = {

		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient
		}
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_marriage_by_command_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_marriage_by_command_ask_value
	add = qpq_marriage_by_command_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Hand-Over
qpq_hand_over_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				OR = {
					is_pool_guest_of = scope:recipient
					is_foreign_court_guest_of = scope:recipient
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				OR = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:recipient
					is_pool_guest_of = scope:recipient
					is_foreign_court_guest_of = scope:recipient
				}
			}
		}
		add = 2
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hand_over_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_hand_over_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_hand_over_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

#### Hush Money

	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hush_money_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_hush_money_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_hush_money_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_hush_money_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}

	value = qpq_hush_money_demand_value
}
qpq_hush_money_offer_points_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
		add = qpq_hush_money_gold_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
		add = -3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		add = -5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_marriage ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_marriage_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_hush_money_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_hush_money_ask_value
	add = qpq_hush_money_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes

	value = 35
	add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy }
		}
		add = -10
	}
}

#### Blessing for a Feud
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

#### Electoral Capitulation
qpq_electoral_capitulation_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

qpq_electoral_capitulation_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_electoral_capitulation_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_electoral_capitulation_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}

	value = 35
	add = { value = qpq_electoral_capitulation_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
}
qpq_electoral_capitulation_offer_points_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy }
		}
		add = -10
	}
}
qpq_electoral_capitulation_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_electoral_capitulation_ask_value
	add = qpq_electoral_capitulation_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Mutual Defense League
qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:qpq_x_armed ?= yes } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_ask_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:actor.liege value <= -20 } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
}

	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_title_swap_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_title_swap_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_title_swap_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_title_swap_ask_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Coup Pact
qpq_coup_pact_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_coup_pact_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
	}

		add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value

		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_partition_pact_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_partition_pact_ask_value
	add = qpq_partition_pact_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

		add = 3

	min = 25
	round = yes

#### Faithless Ally
qpq_faithless_ally_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:secondary_recipient value >= 50 } }
		}
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest }
		}
		add = -10
	}
}

#### Turncoat
qpq_turncoat_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = 5
	min = 0
	max = 5

	multiply = {
		value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value

		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}

		multiply = 20
		max = 45

		multiply = 0.8
	}

qpq_turncoat_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_turncoat_ask_value
	add = qpq_turncoat_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Seed the Separatists
qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient.liege.faith = scope:actor.faith
			NOT = { scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient.liege } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}

		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious }
		}

	}

#### Extradition
qpq_extradition_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:actor } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_extradition_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_extradition_ask_value
	add = qpq_extradition_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Buy a Councillor
qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}

}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
		add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_points_value
	}
	if = {

		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
		add = -3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		add = -5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_marriage ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_marriage_points_value
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_ask_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:recipient.liege value >= 40 } }
		}
		add = -15
	}
}

#### Secret Clause
qpq_secret_clause_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	min = 0
	max = 5

qpq_secret_clause_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_secret_clause_ask_value
	add = qpq_secret_clause_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

			add = 1

			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }

	max = 5

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_ask_value
	add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Steer the Holy War
qpq_steer_the_holy_war_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_steer_the_holy_war_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_steer_the_holy_war_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

#### Purchase a Mitre
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_absolution_by_concession_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_ask_value
	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Holy Warrant
qpq_holy_warrant_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_warrant_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_warrant_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_holy_warrant_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_holy_warrant_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_holy_warrant_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}

		value = qpq_council_lobbying_price_value

			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }

	}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }

	}
	round = yes

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}

			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}

#### Name in the Khutba
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	multiply = {

#### Fatwa for Hire

	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ask_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Fund the Da'wa
qpq_fund_the_dawa_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_fund_the_dawa_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_fund_the_dawa_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	round = yes
}
qpq_favourable_omens_gold_points_value = {
	value = 15
	add = {
		value = qpq_favourable_omens_price_value
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 20
		max = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value

	if = {

		add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value

	}

qpq_favourable_omens_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

#### Consecration Rites
qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = dynasty }
					dynasty = { dynasty_prestige_level <= 1 }
					primary_title.title_held_years < 5
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_consecration_rites_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_consecration_rites_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_consecration_rites_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}

#### Temple Patronage
qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_temple_patronage_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
